name: tesseract
description: Local optical character recognition for Image Tools

storage.rationale: The control-plane host-tool owner retains versioned user-local package payloads and receipts under its managed opt directory, with a managed bin launcher; Image Tools owns model language data and request outputs.

installHint: Install through scenario-dependency-analyzer deps install system/tesseract --scenario tesseract --surface host-tool --apply. English language data is required.
